{{Short description|German professor in electrical engineering}}

'''Ulrich Lemmer''' (born May 1964) is a [[German nationality law|German]] [[Electrical engineering|electrical engineer]] and [[professor]] specializing in [[optoelectronics]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Huber|first=Robert|date=2021-10-14|title=KIT - LTI - Institut - Mitarbeitende|url=https://www.lti.kit.edu/mitarbeiter_lemmer.php|access-date=2021-11-24|website=www.lti.kit.edu|language=de-de}}</ref>

== Education ==
Ulrich Lemmer received a diploma degree in physics from [[RWTH Aachen University]] in 1990 and a Ph.D. from the [[University of Marburg]] in 1995. From 1995 to 1996, he held a postdoctoral position with the [[University of California]] at [[Santa Barbara, California|Santa Barbara]]. <ref>{{Cite web|title=IEEE Explore Ulrich Lemmer|url=https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/author/38579701500|access-date=2021-11-29|website=[[IEEE]]}}</ref>

== Career ==
In 2002, Lemmer was appointed as a full [[Professor]] and director of the Light Technology Institute, [[Karlsruhe Institute of Technology]]. He is also one of the directors of the Institute for Microstructure Technology.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Technology (IMT)|first=Institute of Microstructure|date=2021-07-06|title=KIT - IMT - Research Groups - Lemmer|url=https://www.imt.kit.edu/1352_1485.php|access-date=2021-11-24|website=www.imt.kit.edu|language=en-gb|archive-date=2021-11-24|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211124202257/https://www.imt.kit.edu/1352_1485.php|url-status=dead}}</ref> Lemmer was awarded with the [[Esther Hoffman Beller Medal]] in 2018.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Smith |first=Meredith |last2=Apter |first2=Kari |last3=Gass |first3=Jeanette |date=2018-06-01 |title=2018 OSA Awards and Medals |url=http://dx.doi.org/10.1364/opn.29.6.000041 |journal=Optics and Photonics News |volume=29 |issue=6 |pages=41 |doi=10.1364/opn.29.6.000041 |issn=1047-6938|url-access=subscription }}</ref> The primary reason for the honor was for developing a vision for an international education program in optics that appreciates its importance as an enabling technology, and  for successfully establishing the Karlsruhe School of Optics & Photonics (KSOP).<ref>{{Cite web|last=Optica|first=Ulrich Lemmer|date=2021|title=Optica Ulrich Lemmer|url=https://www.optica.org/history/biographies/bios/ulrich_lemmer/}}</ref> In 2019, he was elected a Fellow of OSA.

== Publications ==
Lemmer is an author of over 400 journal publications, 17 [[Patent|patents]] or patent applications, and 9 books and book articles.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Uli Lemmer|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=0tmWfIAAAAAJ&hl=en|access-date=2021-11-24|website=scholar.google.com}}</ref>
